review_candidates.title: Senior Quality Assurance Specialist, Emerging Africa (Egypt)
review_candidates.description: This is where your work makes a difference. At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride. Summary The Senior QA Specialist is responsible for implementing and maintaining Baxter's Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory compliance activities in Egypt. The role ensures compliance with local regulations, Baxter Quality Standards, ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 requirements, while supporting product quality, patient safety, distributor and supplier oversight, regulatory activities, and business continuity through effective backup planning and training across English and French speaking Africa - Emerging Africa. Key Responsibilities Quality Assurance & Compliance Implement and maintain Baxter's QMS, policies, SOPs, and quality processes. Ensure compliance with local regulations, Baxter Quality Standards, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, GMP, and GDP requirements. Support internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, and corrective action implementation. Manage documentation, SOP lifecycle, training records, and quality system compliance. Complaint Handling & Product Surveillance Act as Local Complaint Coordinator, ensuring effective complaint logging, investigation, reporting, closure, and authority notifications where required. Train customer-facing employees on complaint handling processes. Manage Medical Device Product Surveillance activities, including collection, reporting, and follow-up of adverse events and incidents. Maintain compliant surveillance systems and coordinate with relevant internal functions. Field Actions & Product Safety Serve as Local Field Action Coordinator, ensuring timely execution, communication, reconciliation, and closure of field corrective actions. Coordinate communications with regulatory authorities and customers. Maintain trained backup coordinators for critical safety processes. Distributor, Supplier & Third-Party Quality Management Manage distributor and third-party qualification, assessment, audit, and corrective action programs. Conduct GDP audits and ensure compliance with Baxter quality requirements. Establish and maintain QA Agreements with distributors, suppliers, and relevant partners. Maintain approved supplier lists and oversee supplier quality activities. Quality Systems & Continuous Improvement Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), CAPAs, and Change Control processes. Investigate quality issues and drive timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Support continuous quality improvement initiatives across the region. Product Release & Distribution Quality Ensure product release activities comply with local regulatory requirements. Ensure products are distributed only to authorized entities. Implement and maintain Good Distribution Practices throughout the supply chain. Manage temperature-controlled shipment quality requirements and oversee third-party warehouse quality standards. Business Support Ensure appropriate procedures, training, and business continuity plans are in place for critical systems and processes. Maintain cross-functional collaboration with Supply Chain, Pharmacovigilance, Technical Services, Warehousing & Distribution, and Commercial teams. Qualifications Strong knowledge of GMP, GDP, ISO 9001, and ISO 13485. Ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including Regulatory Authorities, Pharmacovigilance, Supply Chain, Compliance, Technical Services, and third-party partners. Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Self-motivated, proactive, resilient, and able to work independently or within a team. Fluent in English. Preferred candidate location: Cairo, Egypt. Education & Experience Pharmacy Degree required. Minimum 3 years of experience in Quality Assurance within the pharmaceutical or medical device industry. Experience working within regulated healthcare environments and quality management systems. Equal Employment Opportunity Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. Reasonable Accommodations Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. review_candidates.title: Quality Center Center Specialist GSM B2
review_candidates.description: Company Description Xceed is a leading multilingual Business Process Outsourcing provider in the EMEA region, operating more than 10,000 web-enabled multichannel stations. The company serves key government and commercial clients in 10 languages across sites in Egypt, Morocco, Mauritius, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia. Xceed offers a wide range of services including inbound and outbound customer support, back-office operations, infrastructure management, recruitment process outsourcing, helpdesk support, and social media analysis. The organization is widely recognized through multiple international awards for outsourcing excellence, customer experience, sustainability, impact sourcing, diversity, equity, and inclusion. Xceed is also committed to high operational standards, holding multiple ISO and COPC certifications for quality, business continuity, information security, and occupational health and safety. Role Description The Quality Center Specialist GSM B2 is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, responsible for monitoring and improving service quality across contact center operations. In this role, the specialist conducts regular quality audits on customer interactions, evaluates performance against predefined standards, and identifies trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities. Daily tasks include analyzing call and case data, documenting findings, preparing quality reports, and sharing actionable feedback with team leaders and agents. The specialist collaborates with operations, training, and quality assurance teams to support coaching initiatives, refine scripts and processes, and ensure compliance with internal policies and client requirements. The role also involves contributing to continuous improvement projects, supporting calibration sessions, and helping maintain a consistent and high-quality customer experience. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret performance data, identify root causes, and propose practical improvements. Candidates should possess Quality Control and Quality Assurance skills to monitor adherence to standards, ensure consistency, and support corrective actions. Candidates should possess Quality Auditing skills to perform structured evaluations of customer interactions, document findings, and maintain accurate records. Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to deliver clear feedback, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and present quality insights to stakeholders. Relevant experience in contact center or BPO environments, especially in quality-related roles, is highly beneficial. Familiarity with GSM or telecom industry processes and customer journeys is an advantage. Proficiency in using quality monitoring tools, CRM systems, and standard office software (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint) is preferred. Diploma or bachelor’s degree in business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in quality and operations. Ability to work on-site in Cairo, manage multiple priorities, and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

review_candidates.title: Automation SOFTWARE Tester
review_candidates.description: Company Description Amjaad Technology is a leading corporation in IoT and utility management, specializing in smart metering solutions for electricity, water, BTU, and gas. Through its innovative ioMeter System, the company enables utility service providers, real estate developers, and smart cities to drive digital transformation, optimize energy use, and support sustainability goals. Amjaad Technology also develops platforms for community and facilities management in smart cities, enhancing operational efficiency and resource utilization. With over 300 projects delivered across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE, its solutions have positively impacted more than 200,000 people by improving operational performance and supporting sustainable communities. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Automation Tester role based in Qesm El Maadi. The Automation Tester will design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for web and backend systems, ensuring the reliability and performance of Amjaad Technology’s smart metering and IoT platforms. Responsibilities include creating and executing test cases, performing manual and API testing where needed, identifying and documenting defects, and collaborating with developers and product teams to resolve issues. The role also involves contributing to test planning, improving test coverage and processes, and supporting continuous integration and deployment pipelines to maintain high-quality releases. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Quality Assurance skills, including understanding of QA methodologies and test planning. Candidates should possess skills in Manual Testing and writing and executing detailed Test Cases for functional and regression testing. Candidates should possess experience with API Testing, including validating request/response flows and using common API testing tools. Candidates should possess Automation skills, including building and maintaining automated test suites using relevant frameworks and scripting languages. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Familiarity with CI/CD tools, version control systems, and defect tracking systems. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. Experience testing IoT, utilities, or smart metering solutions is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Senior AI Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Requirements: - Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience building, fine-tuning, deploying, and operating AI/ML systems in production environments. - Minimum 3+ years of professional experience using Python, with strong object-oriented programming skills and the ability to write clean, maintainable, production-grade code. - Hands-on experience with open-source and open-weight LLMs including OpenAI GPT-OSS, LLaMA, Mistral, Mixtral, and similar transformer-based models. - Strong understanding of transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, tokenization strategies, and context window management. - Strong hands-on experience with PyTorch and TensorFlow, the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, Datasets, Accelerate), and high-performance LLM inference frameworks including vLLM, Triton Inference Server, and Text Generation Inference (TGI). - Experience with integrating in-memory data stores such as Redis for vector search and retrieval-augmented generation tasks. Job Responsibilities: - Design, build, fine-tune, and operate end-to-end AI systems using Large Language Models (LLMs) for real production use cases, covering model selection, training workflows, inference optimization, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. - Fine-tune and adapt LLMs using instruction tuning, domain adaptation, and parameter-efficient techniques (LoRA, QLoRA, adapters), ensuring model quality, stability, and performance. - Design and build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, including embedding models, vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus), semantic search, chunking strategies, retrieval quality optimization, and grounding techniques. - Develop and serve AI models as standalone AI services exposed via REST / gRPC APIs, optimized for latency, throughput, and cost using batching, quantization, and model parallelism. - Own AI deployment and lifecycle management in production, including versioning, rollback strategies, monitoring (latency, drift, failure modes, cost), and safe model iteration. - Deploy and operate LLMs across environments, using managed AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and self-hosted open-source models on cloud GPU infrastructure (AWS EC2, Azure VMs, GCP Compute), with CI/CD integration for automated deployment and model versioning.
